definitions: To grasp, carry, or support something.
To keep something in a particular position or state.
To have or maintain a belief, opinion, or attitude.
To conduct or preside over a meeting, event, or discussion.
examples: She held the baby gently in her arms.
The bridge can hold a lot of weight.
I hold the view that everyone deserves respect.
They will hold a conference next month.
The rule still holds true today.
